description: Neolithic village sites of the curated list (spec neolithic/villages.md section 2; Yang, 2026-10-25: "curated list sounds good"): excavated villages in regions that had villages but few later cities, here the Linear Pottery culture (LBK) of central Europe, each a village site like the places of future cities. bce is the year the village is dated from, approximate.
